page_title: SAS 1-2 GEN | Sassuolo v Genoa 03/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Ermano Feliciani sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+4' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Genoa players aren’t happy.
90+3' 1 - 2 GOAL! Aaron Martin curls the free kick into the box. Leo Ostigard (Genoa) peels off his marker and arrows a brilliant header past Arijanet Muric and into the left side of the net. 1:2.
90+2' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ermano Feliciani had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' A pass by Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle and signals a foul after Junior Messias (Genoa) brought his opponent down.
89' Junior Messias (Genoa) does superbly to reach the lofted pass from Caleb Ekuban into the centre of the box, but his header is weak and drifts well past the left post.

88' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
88' Aaron Martin (Genoa) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

87' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
87' Luca Moro (Sassuolo) commits a foul during an attacking move.
86' Fabio Grosso decides to make a substitution. Andrea Pinamonti will be replaced by Luca Moro (Sassuolo).
85' Substitution. Albert Gronbaek (Genoa) on for Morten Thorsby.
83' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ermano Feliciani saw the whole situation.
81' Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
81' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.

79' Junior Messias (Genoa) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
78' Fabio Grosso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) replacing Domenico Berardi.
78' The substitution has been made. Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) has replaced Josh Doig.
77' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
76' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Aaron Martin (Genoa) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
76' Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) brings his opponent down. Ermano Feliciani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa are awarded a free kick.
73' What was Patrizio Masini (Genoa) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
71' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is flagged for offside.
70' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nicola Leali intercepts the ball.
68' Roberto Murgita has decided to substitute Alessandro Marcandalli and he is replaced by Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa).
68' We are about to witness a substitution. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) is replacing Lorenzo Colombo.
67' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Armand Lauriente will be replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
64' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) replaces Ismael Kone.
63' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
62' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
61' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in a cross from the corner, but Arijanet Muric reads it well and gathers the ball.
60' A lofted cross from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Genoa earn a corner.
59' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
59' Roberto Murgita prepares a substitution. Vitinha is replaced by Junior Messias (Genoa).
59' Substitution. Patrizio Masini (Genoa) replaces Ruslan Malinovskyi.
58' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.

56' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Nicola Leali, who pulls off a decent save!

53' What a chance that is! Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
51' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
50' The corner from Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is intercepted by Arijanet Muric.
49' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Genoa can continue in their attacking effort.
47' 1 - 1 The ball from the corner slips through the box to Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) and he slots it into the bottom right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
47' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) will deliver the corner kick.
46' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Sassuolo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Ermano Feliciani has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The resulting corner from Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+3' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
45+2' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Arijanet Muric leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Aaron Martin (Genoa).
45+1' The ball is cleared after Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
43' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
43' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) jumps into a tackle and Ermano Feliciani signals a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Sassuolo.
42' Ismael Kone races towards the box before laying off to Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
41' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
39' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
38' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) was quite harsh and Ermano Feliciani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.

35' A nice lofted cross finds Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save.
33' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Josh Doig, but his close-range header slips just over the bar.
33' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
32' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
31' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

30' The ball is laid off to Vitinha (Genoa) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Arijanet Muric to make a decent save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Genoa.
29' Ruslan Malinovskyi passes to Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
27' Some trickery by Nemanja Matic allows him to set up Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) on the edge of the box , and he blasts the ball at goal but it misses the right post by a whisker.

26' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
25' A crossfield pass from Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates.
24' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Vitinha (Genoa), but the defence gets it clear.
21' Vitinha (Genoa) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Brooke Norton-Cuffy, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
20' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) sends a long ball in, but Nicola Leali comfortably gathers the ball.
18' 0 - 1 Goal! Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 0:1.
18' Aaron Martin (Genoa) whips in a cross from the corner, but Arijanet Muric is well positioned and punches the ball away.

18' Vitinha (Genoa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Genoa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' Vitinha (Genoa) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
16' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
15' Vitinha (Genoa) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
13' Vitinha (Genoa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
12' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
11' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) and Armand Lauriente attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
10' A pass into the penalty area from Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is intercepted by the defence.
9' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Sassuolo will have a throw-in.
8' Vitinha (Genoa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
7' The corner kick from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

7' Vitinha (Genoa) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Genoa will take a corner kick.
5' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
4' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
1' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Genoa will take the kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani is introduced as the referee for today's match.
